source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
You need enough information to summarise what actually happened in order to determine what counts.
3. This information may be recorded as free-text narrative on an incident form and/or provided by the injured employee in personal statements made as part of the investigation. It may also be recorded as information selected from tick boxes or drop-down lists.
4. The event at the heart of the incident may seem ambiguous but it is important that you understand it.
5. Work trough the scenario below, then try this worksheet.

Consider these questions:

<i>“In September 2015 a man returned to work after a period of sick leave and was given a phased-return. He suffered back pain on the morning of 10 September as he was lifting his laptop (it was a heavy school laptop). He was aware his back was vulnerable and took care when lifting; trying to keep the bag close to his body, bending his knees etc
